domain: Adjudication probe for round 1 PROBE-DISAGREEMENT targeting: rules on the disputed pair at charter :36/:54 (rating-scale underdetermination vs policy-field-is-one-dial), deciding on the filed contracts rather than by taste, and reporting any new defect the contradiction exposes.
axioms: A disputed location is decided on the filed contracts where they decide it; only where they do not is it an irreducible taste call.
Two defects at one location are ranked, not averaged: state which dominates and whether remedying one worsens the other.
Precision applied to a malformed object launders it; check that a proposed repair does not remove the visible softness that flags a result as non-load-bearing.
failure_mode: Bounded to the disputed location; it does not sweep for new regions.
Can over-credit whichever prior finding cites more source contracts.
